The test image shows tomato leaves with a distinctive mottled/mosaic pattern — alternating light (pale green/white) and darker green areas across the leaf surface. No distinct brown lesions or fungal growth visible. This pattern strongly suggests a viral disease (mosaic) or possibly powdery mildew.

Let me read the part index, then check reference images.

The affected part is **leaf**. Top candidates from the leaf set: Cucumber_Mosaic_Virus, Powdery_Mildew, Tomato_Spotted_Wilt_Virus, Verticillium_Wilt.

Starting with CMV reference:
CMV reference shows more distorted/shoestring leaves. The test image has broader leaves with a white/pale mottled pattern. Checking Powdery Mildew:
Powdery mildew shows discrete white spots, not the pervasive pale mottling in the test image. Checking TSWV:
TSWV shows discrete dark necrotic spots, not matching. The test image has pervasive pale/white mottling across whole leaf surfaces. Checking Leaf_Mold:
Verticillium shows wilting/V-shaped yellowing, not the test pattern. The test image has pale interveinal mottling across all leaves. Let me check another Powdery Mildew reference and CMV whole plant:
This powdery mildew image shows a uniform grayish-white dusting. The test image has more of a mottled pattern with clear green and pale areas. Checking CMV whole plant:
CMV whole plant shows severely distorted/stunted leaves, not matching. Let me check one more Powdery Mildew and Early Blight reference:

The Powdery Mildew CDDM_1036 reference shows pervasive whitish-gray coverage across leaves with some green remaining — this closely matches the test image's pale/mottled pattern with normal leaf shape.

**Summary of comparisons:**
- **CMV**: Severely distorted/shoestring leaves — doesn't match
- **TSWV**: Discrete dark necrotic spots — doesn't match  
- **Leaf Mold**: Yellowish-olive discoloration — doesn't match
- **Verticillium Wilt**: Wilting/V-shaped lesions — doesn't match
- **Powdery Mildew (CDDM_1036)**: Pervasive whitish coating with some green remaining, normal leaf shape — **closest visual match** to the test image's pale, mottled leaves

The test image shows multiple tomato leaves all uniformly covered with a pale whitish-gray mottled pattern, consistent with advanced powdery mildew coverage spreading across leaf surfaces.
